title: SkinsLib
description: This project adds an in‑game skin library: browse/search skins, preview them, import by username or PNG (drag/drop supported), and apply a selected skin directly to your player.
body:
# Skins lib

A modern, ever-growing library of roleplay and funny skins.

SkinsLib makes managing and applying Minecraft skins fast and simple. Browse a growing collection of skins, preview them live, and apply them instantly from an easy-to-use interface.

Features
Browse & Search

Quickly find skins using the built-in search bar and scroll through the skin grid.

One-Click Apply

Select any skin and apply it instantly in-game.

Live Preview

Preview skins in real time with:

Slim and wide model support
Lighting
Idle animation
Context Actions

Right-click a skin to open additional options, such as deleting it (where allowed).

Import Options

Add new skins in multiple ways:

By Minecraft username
From a local PNG file
Drag & Drop

Drag a .png file into the screen, give it a name, and import it instantly.

Usage
Open SkinsLib from your client GUI.
Use the search field to find skins.
Left-click a skin to select and apply it.
Right-click a skin to open the context menu (for example delete, where allowed).
To import skins:
Click Add Skin → Add By Username
Click Add Skin → Add From PNG
Or drag a .png file onto the screen.
Controls
Left-click — Select or apply a skin
Right-click — Open the context menu on a skin
Scroll — Navigate the skin grid
Drag preview — Click and drag inside the preview to rotate or tilt the model
Import Tips
Use 64×64 PNG skin files (standard Minecraft format).
Names are auto-suggested, but you can edit them before confirming.
Newly imported skins are not automatically selected; choose them from the grid.
Requirements
Fabric Loader (matching your Minecraft version)
Fabric API
Installation
Download the latest .jar from Modrinth.
Place the file in your mods/ folder.
Launch Minecraft using Fabric with Fabric API installed.
Compatibility
Client-side mod — does not require server installation.
Works alongside most cosmetic and GUI mods.
If you encounter conflicts, please report them.
